children: Range Impact restructured prior option arrangements by issuing equity and terminating related rights. On September 30, 2026, the company sold 654,434 unregistered shares to MRR CNG for $500,000 and 654,434 shares to Wicks Building for $500,000, both priced at $0.764 per share (September 2026 VWAP). Concurrently, Range Impact’s subsidiary ended MRR’s land purchase option for ~1,500 acres in Eastern Kentucky and Wicks’ membership interest and cash distribution option, with no exit fees. The previously paid $1.0 million in option fees was applied to the stock purchases, simplifying the capital structure and converting contingent rights into equity.
